name: ros-livekit-bridge
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && mkdir -p src/externals && if [ -f external.repos ]; then vcs import --skip-existing src/externals < external.repos; fi && rosdep update && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -d src/externals ]; then for repo in src/externals/*; do if [ -d "$repo/.git" ]; then if [ -z "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain)" ]; then git -C "$repo" pull --recurse-submodules; else echo "Skipping pull for $repo because it has local changes"; fi; fi; done; fi'
